summary: Introduced auth.directory (is_known_user/verify/remember) and migrated auth.routes' internal logic onto it, keeping _user_cache alive and synchronized for notes' existing import. 5 new contract tests prove the two caches agree across register/login-hit/login-cold/profile/unknown-user scenarios. Approved with one flagged judgment call (profile() backfills _user_cache from directory on a cache-hit lookup) accepted as-is.
